systems.name: Gloam
systems.notes: Dim red star, heavily spotted; its light wavers over weeks. Gloam is tidally locked to it.

control.note: The night side is contested; see its areas.

bodies.notes: Tidally locked to a dim red star, with one face in permanent day and the other in permanent night. The day side is a dry, wind-scoured desert under a sun that never moves. The night side is frozen solid, cold enough to stop an unheated reactor, and full of lattice. Between them runs the twilight band, a strip a few hundred kilometers wide where people can live, and that is where Gloam's settlements are. About 110,000 people live under the Gloam Purview, a holding of Harrison Armory.

bodies.name: Purview orbital yards
bodies.notes: Over the past five years these yards have printed a squadron of eight frigates and corvettes from Armory licenses that exist nowhere else in the Basin.

bodies.name: Gloam gun platforms
bodies.notes: Orbital guns covering Gloam's two lane mouths. Nobody has yet tested them.

bodies.name: Ember's belt
bodies.notes: The only notable feature of the region's second star.

places.name: Terminus (WIP)
places.notes: Seat of Colonel-Governor Aurélien Castaigne and the Purview's administration, in the twilight band.

places.name: Coldwell
places.notes: The largest camp of the Coldwell Claims, whose miners hold Allotment claims the Purview does not recognize. The Purview has cleared eleven camps and deported about nine hundred people to the Marrow; the miners fight from the deep workings with frames smuggled in aboard Free Lines landers.

places.name: The deep workings
places.notes: Night-side lattice workings. Below about four hundred meters, crews have found Absent machinery that is still awake.

places.name: Cleared camps
places.notes: Camps of the Coldwell Claims cleared by Purview troops since the winter of 5028u.
